news.headline: Evercore ISI initiates Tenax Therapeutics at Outperform ahead of Phase 3 LEVEL data
news.summary: Evercore ISI initiated coverage of TENX with an Outperform rating and a $39 price target, modeling roughly 50% probability of success for the Phase 3 LEVEL trial versus only a 20-25% chance it says is priced into the current stock. The firm frames the setup as offering 250% to 10x upside on positive data against steep downside if the trial misses.

news.headline: Tenax sets Phase 3 LEVEL data for late-breaking ESC Congress 2026 slot in Munich
news.summary: Tenax announced that topline Phase 3 LEVEL results for TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in PH-HFpEF will be unveiled in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the ESC Congress 2026 in Munich (August 28-31), presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University. The announcement pins the previously guided Q3 2026 data window to a specific date, August 29, 2026.

news.headline: Tenax locks in long-term Orion manufacturing deal, extends levosimendan license to 2035
news.summary: Orion Corporation exercised its option to become the primary manufacturer and supplier of oral levosimendan under a new five-year Supply Agreement with automatic renewals, while the companies amended their 2013 License Agreement to push the deadline for U.S. regulatory approval out to December 31, 2035. The deal de-risks commercial-scale drug supply ahead of the Phase 3 readout.

news.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates Overweight on Tenax Therapeutics into LEVEL readout
news.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Olivia Brayer Saunders reaffirmed an Overweight rating and $35 price target on TENX, citing renewed investor interest as the Phase 3 LEVEL data, then guided for Q3 2026, approaches. The note pointed to growing Street attention on the binary catalyst as a key driver of recent share strength.

news.headline: Guggenheim lifts Tenax Therapeutics price target to $40, raises trial success odds to 80%
news.summary: Guggenheim maintained its Buy rating and raised its TENX price target to $40 from $34 while increasing its probability-of-success estimate for the Phase 3 LEVEL trial to 80% from 75%. The firm noted Tenax is the only company running a Phase 3 trial in PH-HFpEF, a condition with no approved treatments.

news.headline: Piper Sandler more than doubles Tenax Therapeutics price target to $50 ahead of trial data
news.summary: Piper Sandler kept its Overweight rating and raised its price target 150% to $50 from $20, citing rising confidence heading into the Phase 3 LEVEL topline results and highlighting CMO Dr. Stuart Rich's standing as a key opinion leader in pulmonary hypertension. The note cited the trial's improved statistical power following the December 2025 blinded sample-size re-estimation.

catalysts.label: LEVEL Phase 3 data presented at ESC Congress 2026
catalysts.detail: A Late-Breaking Clinical Science session in Munich will present full topline results of the Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah; this is the single binary event the market is pricing into TENX shares.

catalysts.label: LEVEL trial database lock and topline readout
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for database lock, statistical analysis, and topline disclosure on the primary 6-minute walk distance endpoint during August 2026, aligning with the ESC Congress presentation date.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings / corporate update
catalysts.detail: Tenax has not yet announced a specific date for its second-quarter 2026 financial results and corporate update call; based on the Q1 2026 report (released May 12, 2026) it is expected in August 2026, likely bracketing the LEVEL data release.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 global trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, ex-US LEVEL-2 registrational trial of oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF is ongoing, with enrollment completion targeted by the end of 2027 ahead of a potential NDA filing.

pulse: With roughly four weeks left until the make-or-break Phase 3 LEVEL data unveil at the ESC Congress on August 29, 2026, Tenax Therapeutics shares (recently around $16, ~$429M market cap) remain a binary bet on oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF. Sell-side sentiment has grown steadily more bullish into the catalyst, with Evercore ISI's new Outperform initiation joining upgrades from Guggenheim (80% probability of success, $40 target), Cantor Fitzgerald and Piper Sandler ($50 target), while the new long-term Orion supply agreement and license extension to 2035 removes manufacturing risk if the trial succeeds. With roughly $118.8M in cash funding operations into 2028, the near-term story is entirely about the August readout, with a Q2 2026 earnings update likely to land around the same window.
